create_TokenizedFile: create a TokenizedFile instance to write tokenized documents with index and loss metadata to a local or remote folder
run_DocumentTokenizer: run the DocumentTokenizer pipeline step to batch tokenize documents and shuffle them into output files
build_TokenizedFile_shuffle: build a shuffled TokenizedFile by copying document bytes in a new random order with optional chunk-level shuffling
test_write_loss_metadata: test writing loss mask bytes alongside token bytes for selective token loss masking during training
summarize_DocumentTokenizer_run: summarize the DocumentTokenizer run method that tokenizes documents, writes unshuffled output, and applies document and chunk shuffling
